title: Apartment Ownership(Special Provisions)
long_title: AN ACT TO FACILITATE THE REGISTRATION OF PLANS OF CERTAIN CONDOMINIUM PROPERTIES INTENDED TO BE DISPOSED OF BY THE COMMISSIONER FOR NATIONAL HOUSING OR THE NATIONAL HOUSING DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY AND TO AMEND THE APARTMENT OWNERSHIP LAW NO. 11 OF 1973

edition.caveat: private republisher, not the Government Printer. The page is NOT a clean as-enacted text: section 3 is printed as substituted by Act No. 27 of 2002. Section 3 has been restored to the 1999 text from the Government Printer PDF held at data/legal-sources/library/amendments/incoming/4-1999-apartment-ownership-law-amendment.pdf; all other sections agree with that PDF.

editorial_notes: Checked section by section against the Government Printer PDF (5 pp., text layer, certified 10th March, 1999): 7 sections, headings and text agree except section 3, corrected as recorded on that node.
Section 6: the parser kept the inserted by-law 2(dd) both as the tail of the section text and as a child node; the words are printed once. Left as parsed.

Part I (sections 2 and 3) is a standalone registration scheme; Part II (sections 4 to 6) amends the Law: section 3(1) wording, the definition of 'Condominium Plan' in section 26, and by-law 2 of the Second Schedule.

body.heading: Short title.
body.raw_text: 1. This Act may be cited as the Apartment Ownership (Special Provisions) Act, No. 4 of 1999.
body.text: This Act may be cited as the Apartment Ownership (Special Provisions) Act, No. 4 of 1999.

body.heading: Amendment of section 3 of Law, No. 11 of 1973.
body.raw_text: 4. Section 3 of the Apartment Ownership Law, No. 11 of 1973 (hereinafter in this Part referred to as the "principal enactment") is hereby amended in subsection (1) of that section, by the substitution for the words "the Condominium Property (hereinafter referred to as "Condominium Plan")", of the words "the Condominium Property.".

body.heading: Amendment of section 26 of the principal enactment.
body.raw_text: 5. Section 26 of the principal enactment as amended by Act No. 45 of 1982, is hereby further amended in the definition of the expression "Condominium Plan", by the substitution for the words " means a plan of registered land" of the words "means a plan of a Condominium Property".
